 All Highlights Fours Sixes Wicket UDRS 32.6 Anshul Kamboj to Jacob Duffy, no run, a highly respectful defence from Duffy to make the end of a sensation outing for AK47. 10 overs, 22 runs, 2 wickets. Must be a satisfying feeling for Kamboj 32.5 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, 1 run, loud shout of yes as he hurriedly takes off for the single, after tapping this length delivery to cover 32.4 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, no run, beaten ! The last thing he will want trying to farm the strike is to be dismissed! Short of a length delivery nipping away outside off stump, GP pokes at it away from the body as he gets sucked in by the away moment. So close to the outside edge 32.3 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, no run, short delivery, pulled through backward square leg but they won't take the run. GP wants to farm the strike 32.2 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, no run, short of length delivery, GP defends off the back foot 32.1 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, no run, GP is still not comfortable pulling the short ball. Goes for it and misses as he takes his eyes off the ball for a wee bit and falls over to the off-side. KL really liked the direction of the ball as it was coming straight at GP's head. Encourages AK by clapping 30.6 4 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, FOUR , overpitched this time and belted past mid-off. He didn't find the gap at cover previous ball, so he aims straighter and goes for the off-drive 30.5 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, no run, follows up with a fullish delivery, GP drives to cover 30.4 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, 2 runs, oh there's a lot of bounce in this pitch and GP is very lucky he didn't hit this to hand. Just hung his bat out as he tried to bail out of the pull very late, the bumper flew off the bat and landed safely at mid-wicket where there is no fielder 30.3 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, no run, inside edge onto pad, GP thinks about a run but a loud call of "wait, wait" from Jamieson calms things down. Fullish and around the off stump, Phillips wanted to drive through the off-side, ball went to mid-wicket instead 30.2 Anshul Kamboj to Kyle Jamieson, 1 run, pushed to cover 30.1 Anshul Kamboj to Kyle Jamieson, no run, beaten ! AK is bowling a great line and length today. Kept this just outside off stump and got it to nip away, Jamieson wanted a drive and missed it 28.6 Anshul Kamboj to Kyle Jamieson, no run, length delivery outside off at 131ks, Jamieson mistimes the drive to Arshdeep at mid-on 28.5 Anshul Kamboj to Kyle Jamieson, no run, 131ks length delivery outside off, Jamieson hangs back and dabs it to the right of backward point 28.4 Anshul Kamboj to Kyle Jamieson, no run, another bumper just outside off at 134ks, Jamieson drops his gloves and lets it pass 28.4 Anshul Kamboj to Kyle Jamieson, wide , a fiery bouncer to welcome the new batter, Jamieson half-ducks and lets it go 28.3 W Anshul Kamboj to Nathan Smith, out Caught by Virat Kohli!! Wowza from Virat Kohli. Try stopping me if you can is the celebration from VK as he runs away briefly before tossing the ball back towards the umpire. He feels it's a clean catch. Fingers underneath the ball says the telly umpire. Gone. Kohli is pumped as he does a "told ya" to someone in the huddle. It was full and inviting the drive, Smith fell for the trap and went hard at it. Thick outside edge flies low to the right of second slip where Kohli times his dive to pluck the ball inches above the turf. Must say that is a quality catch from one of India's finest. Kohli also did the "Bow and Arrow" celebration before sticking his tongue out whilst exchanging a cheeky smile with one of his mates. Nathan Smith c Virat Kohli b Anshul Kamboj 1(9) 28.2 Anshul Kamboj to Nathan Smith, no run, back of a length outside off at 131ks, Smith jumps on the back foot and cuts to Axar at backward point 28.1 Anshul Kamboj to Nathan Smith, no run, pitched up outside off at 137ks, Smith looks to play an expansive drive and ends up skewing a thick inside edge that goes onto hit his back leg 26.6 Anshul Kamboj to Nathan Smith, no run, a wicket maiden from Anshul Kamboj as Smith defends the 133ks length delivery to Axar at backward point 26.5 Anshul Kamboj to Nathan Smith, no run, that is atop nut from Anshul Kamboj. At 134ks skiddy length delivery with extra bounce outside off, Smith hops and withdraws his bat from harm's away at the last possible instant 26.4 Anshul Kamboj to Nathan Smith, no run, short of length outside off at 133ks, Smith hops and fends it to Kohli at cover 26.3 Anshul Kamboj to Nathan Smith, no run, beaten! 137ks in the testing channel outside off, Smith hangs his bat out to dry and gets beaten on the outside edge 26.2 Anshul Kamboj to Nathan Smith, no run, short of length outside off, left alone to the keeper 26.1 W Anshul Kamboj to Mitchell Santner, out Bowled!! Dragged on? Hit the inside edge, nutmegs him, grazes the back leg and then rolls on to hit the pegs. Six down New Zealand. 134ks fullish delivery that moved into the left hander. Santner was not fully forward, wanted to push into the off-side and ended up playing it back onto the stumps. In deep trouble are the home side. Oh hang on? This is absolutely bizarre. The ball actually never hit the back leg. In fact it went between the legs and was heading towards short fine leg but the moment it landed on the pitch it randomly decided to steer right and hit the top of middle stump. That spun like a proper off-break, probably off the lines the batter draw to mark their guard on the crease. Santner could not believe his luck. Mitchell Santner b Anshul Kamboj 4(16) 24.6 Anshul Kamboj to Mitchell Santner, no run, fuller and just outside off at 133ks, Santner gets forward and pushes it to cover 24.5 Anshul Kamboj to Mitchell Santner, no run, nearly squared up. Opens Santner up on the back foot and gets him to splice the dab to Axar at backward point. Perfect back of a length and a hint of extra bounce on the 129ks delivery from Anshul Kamboj 24.4 Anshul Kamboj to Mitchell Santner, no run, back of a length on the stumps at 132ks, punched to mid-off 24.3 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, 1 run, mistimed pull lands well short of the fielder. Short ball bowled well wide of off at 135ks, Phillips fetched that with a swivel and the toe-edge landed well short of Shreyas Iyer at deep square to his left 24.2 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, no run, full ball at 130ks on the stumps, Phillips pushes the drive to the left of mid-on 24.1 Anshul Kamboj to Glenn Phillips, no run, fuller and closer to off at 132ks, Phillips drives to the right of short extra cover 15.6 Anshul Kamboj to Tom Latham, no run, drops it on length, Tom Latham is forward in his block 15.5 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run, continues to keep it short and Daryl Mitchell swivels and turns it to his left for an easy single 15.4 Anshul Kamboj to Tom Latham, 1 run, comes in with the angle around off stump, pinning Latham on the crease. He gets an outside half of the bat on it, and the ball rolls down to third man 15.3 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run, shuffles across for this back of a length delivery and works it through mid-wicket for a single 15.2 Anshul Kamboj to Tom Latham, 1 run, fullish outside off, Tom Latham sort of opens the bat face and steers it to third man for a single 15.1 Anshul Kamboj to Tom Latham, no run, 134kph, short of a good length around off from round the wicket, Tom Latham is happy to leave it alone 13.6 4 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, FOUR , phew, that's been slapped down the ground! Short and just outside off, and Mitchell stands tall to hammer it past the bowler's right for a boundary 13.5 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, 135kph, shortish once again and Daryl Mitchell stands tall and punches it along the carpet to mid-off 13.4 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, 136kph - that hard length once again close to off, Daryl Mitchell is happy to block after taking a step forward 13.3 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, 1 run, into the pitch at 138 kph, Tim Seifert mistimes the pull to deep mid-wicket for a single 13.2 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, no run, shortish around off, Tim Seifert stays on the back foot and defends it into the off side 13.1 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, no run, slants into the pads as Seifert moves across to clip it away but is struck on the pads. The ball was sliding down the leg, though 11.6 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, really good bowling this from Anshul Kamboj! Continues with his hard length and Daryl Mitchell blocks, once again 11.5 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, 136kph, Daryl Mitchell takes a step forward but Anshul Kamboj doesn't give him the length to go down the ground - defended 11.4 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, 139 kph! Kamboj puts in extra effort, dropping it short outside off. There's some movement away off the surface, and Mitchell has a waft at it but is beaten 11.3 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, fullish close to off at 137kph, Daryl Mitchell prods across and forward and blocks it back to Anshul Kamboj 11.2 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, 1 run, a bit too full on this occasion and Tim Seifert eases into a drive as the ball rolls to mid-off 11.1 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, 1 run, keeps it on length outside off as Daryl Mitchell moves across and inside edges the block to the on side for a single 9.6 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, Kamboj has started really well here! Follows up a maiden with a one-run over. This one is on the shorter side, and Mitchell is happy to stay back and defend. End of first powerplay 9.5 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, drags his length even further outside off, Daryl Mitchell rides the bounce and drops it in front of the cover 9.4 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, just short of a good length, Daryl Mitchell is on the front foot and defends it to mid-on 9.3 Anshul Kamboj to Daryl Mitchell, no run, on good length at 137kph, Daryl Mitchell is nice and forward in his defence 9.2 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, 1 run, tailing into the pads, Tim Seifert is quick on it with a tuck to the right of mid-wicket for a single 9.1 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, no run, nips back in again off the length and almost cuts Seifert in half. He fends at it and is probably struck on the arm 7.6 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, no run, maiden over! Tim Seifert can only gently tuck this length delivery to the fielder at mid-wicket 7.5 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, no run, a bit of a stare-down between Kamboj and Seifert. The right-hander comes forward, gets to the pitch of the ball and plays it straight back to the bowler, who holds his gaze 7.4 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, no run, hits the good length and angling in just a bit, Tim Seifert eases it back to the bowler who mocks a throw 7.3 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, no run, no movement on this one as Tim Seifert stands tall and punches this length delivery into the off side. Fails to clear the inner circle 7.2 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, no run, fullish around off, Tim Seifert drives it straight to the fielder at mid-off 7.1 Anshul Kamboj to Tim Seifert, no run, fullish on the pads, Tim Seifert misses on a clip and is hit on the front pad - going down LATEST NEWS
